name: Grinding
strategy: Outlast opponents through endurance, attrition, battlefield repairs, and reorganizing damaged forces.
designNote: Grinding combines the former Grinding and Recursion doctrines. Its commands may emphasize either surviving prolonged engagements or becoming increasingly effective as the battle continues.

commands.name: Unbroken Line
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit that has already suffered an Attack this Phase is attacked again, it gains Tough 2 against the incoming Attack.

commands.name: Wear Them Down
commands.effect: Choose an enemy Engaged with the active Unit that was already attacked by a different friendly Unit this Round. Reduce that enemy's next Melee Attack by up to two Attack dice, minimum one die remaining, before the end of its next Combat activation.

commands.name: Reform and Recover
commands.effect: Either Heal 2 accumulated Damage from the active Unit, or remove Withdrawn and one temporary Hit, Move, or Evade penalty from it. Defeated Models are not restored.

commands.name: Attrition Engine
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next Attack against an enemy that has already suffered unsaved Damage from a different friendly Unit this Round.

commands.name: Relentless Veterans
commands.effect: When the active Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy that has lost a Model or has accumulated unsaved Damage, its next Melee Attack against that enemy this Combat Phase gains +1 Attack die and Critical 1. This checks the defender's current casualties/Damage, not any previous attacker-target history.

doctrineIdentity.summary: Grinding focuses on endurance and cumulative advantage. Its commands support three approaches:

approaches.name: Endurance
approaches.description: Unbroken Line and Reform and Recover help Units withstand damage and maintain effectiveness.

approaches.name: Attrition
approaches.description: Wear Them Down and Attrition Engine reward applying sustained pressure to enemy formations.

approaches.name: Prolonged Engagements
approaches.description: Relentless Veterans improves a Unit's performance against opponents it has already fought.

doctrineIdentity.flexibility: A player can lean toward defensive durability, offensive attrition, or a combination of both depending on which three Commands are selected.
doctrineIdentity.limitation: Grinding does not restore defeated Models or Units. Those effects remain available through faction-specific abilities and other exceptional rules.

distinctionFromOtherDoctrines.distinction: Rewards holding defensive positions and preparing for attacks.
Rewards reactions and retaliation against enemy attacks.
Rewards enduring damage, reorganizing forces, and repeatedly engaging the same enemies.
Rewards maintaining large formations and overwhelming enemies numerically.
